result.reason: The clause adds the annual cap, business-hours restriction, confidentiality requirement, independent auditor, and prohibition on systems access. However, requiring the audit to be permitted “within 30 days” after a request does not provide Customer with 30 days’ advance written notice. Cost shifting also applies to any “discrepancy” over 5%, rather than specifically an underpayment over 5%. Moving the cost paragraph ahead of subsection (b) is unnecessary and creates awkward structure, though unrelated commercial intent is otherwise preserved.
